name: AgentSimulator - Default
description: The stand-in agent at rest, and the only reason the exchange can be demonstrated where no real agent can attach. It is no longer rendered just because this is a dev build: on the map page it now takes a deliberate ?agentPanel=1, because an agent driving an ordinary `npm run dev` session used to find this launcher on every real map and press it. Here in isolation it is shown unconditionally - the gate lives at the call site, not in the component.
